named_events.loss_description: Based on the July 2019 Lloyd's RDS submission, the largest RDS was a North-East USA windstorm event with an industry loss estimate of $81 billion. This equates to a loss to the Syndicate of $206.7 million gross and $26.6 million net of reinsurance recoveries and reinstatement costs.
The large currency shortfall in Japanese Yen is partly driven by the gross claims for Typhoons Hagibis, Faxai and Jebi being mainly in Japanese Yen but any recoveries being in US Dollars.

data.standardized_narrative: At 1 January 2019 the Syndicate's gross claims outstanding were GBP 126.111m. Using the Syndicate's gross claims development (cumulative incurred) table, the 2017 underwriting year shows adverse development between its one-year and two-year diagonals, giving a net prior-year strengthening of approximately GBP 6.485m (c.5.1% of opening gross reserves). The movement is attributable to adverse claims development/large loss development on older underwriting years. The report also highlights significant 2019 catastrophe activity (eg. Typhoons Hagibis, Faxai and Jebi and a North-East USA windstorm RDS) which are discussed elsewhere in the document.
raw_causal_phrases: The large currency shortfall in Japanese Yen is partly driven by the gross claims for Typhoons Hagibis, Faxai and Jebi being mainly in Japanese Yen but any recoveries being in US Dollars.
The principal assumption underlying the liability estimates is that the future claims development will follow a similar pattern to past claims development experience.
data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development derived from the gross claims development (cumulative incurred) table (gross triangle) - only the 2017 underwriting year was mature enough to contribute (2018 and 2019 excluded as the two most recent years). No explicit sentence in the report quantifying a gross prior year movement was found; the triangle calculation is used (confidence 0.8). Named-event amounts quoted in the report were given in USD; no GBP-converted figures were provided, so net loss amounts for named events are recorded as null.
